summary.text: Thomas Palenske is the Republican candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 121, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Kelsey Stock.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired U.S. Air Force brigadier general, special operations helicopter pilot and Kansas small-business owner.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Palenske served in the U.S. Air Force from 1986 to 2025, according to Ballotpedia.

He earned a high school diploma from Topeka West High School, a bachelor's degree from Friends University in 1995, and graduate degrees from Troy State University in 1998 and George Washington University in 2002.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Topeka, began his military career in the Kansas Army National Guard as a helicopter mechanic and door gunner, and served on more than 25 combat deployments, including in Iraq and Afghanistan.
Palenske defeated incumbent Mike Storm in the Republican primary for District 121 on August 4, 2026, with 52.1 percent of the vote.
In the survey, he said he lives in Olathe with his wife, Jeryn, and described himself as a traditional conservative Republican.
He listed property tax relief, adequate and equitable school funding including special education, and a focus on veterans' services and public safety among his priorities.
